title: Topic 13
japanese_text:
A：来年引っ越すって聞いたんだけど、転勤？
B：そう。うちの部署、５年<u>周期</u>で大規模な<u>配置転換</u>があって。
A：そっか。どこに住むの？
B：うーん、東京<u>近郊</u>ならどこでもいいんだけど、<u>強いて</u>言うなら千葉かな。
english_translation: A: I heard you're moving next year. A transfer? B: Yes. Our department reassigns personnel on a five-year cycle. A: I see. Where will you live? B: Well, anywhere in the Tokyo suburbs would be fine, but if I had to say, probably Chiba.
